headline: 832 billion soums withheld in 9 months from employers who delayed wages
summary: Uzbekistan's state labour inspectorate recovered 832 billion soum in delayed wages for nearly 35,000 employees over nine months. Over 36,000 labour law violations were identified, mostly in the private sector.
why: Wage arrears and labour enforcement affect household incomes, consumer spending and the operating risk of employers in Uzbekistan's economy.
original_headline: Ish haqini kechiktirgan ish beruvchilardan 9 oyda 832 mlrd so‘m undirildi
